about: The built-in "/" commands and /model values per agent kind. The Rust helper (xplat/flockbook-modfeed commands.rs, models.rs) and the Mac app (HerdrKit SlashCommands) each hold these tables in code; a test on each side compares its tables with this file, so they stay in step. Change all three together.
